
# HostelFix

> HostelFix is a smart hostel complaint and maintenance management platform that helps students report hostel issues, track complaint resolution, and enables hostel wardens and maintenance staff to manage operations efficiently.

## About HostelFix

HostelFix provides a centralized platform for managing hostel maintenance complaints and improving communication between students, wardens, and maintenance staff.

## Core Features

- Student complaint registration with descriptions and photo attachments.
- Real-time complaint status tracking.
- Warden dashboard for complaint review, prioritization, and staff assignment.
- Staff dashboard for managing assigned maintenance tasks.
- Photo-based proof of completed maintenance work.
- Complaint analytics and resolution statistics.
- Role-based authentication and access control.

## Public Pages

- [Homepage](https://hostel-fix-kappa.vercel.app/): Official HostelFix landing page.

## Technology Stack

- Frontend: React.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS.
- Backend: Node.js, Express.js.
- Database: MongoDB Atlas.
- Authentication: Google OAuth.
- Image Storage: Cloudinary.
- Deployment: Vercel and Render.

## Platform Information

HostelFix is designed to streamline hostel maintenance operations, improve accountability, and provide transparency throughout the complaint resolution process.

## Important Notes

- Private dashboards require authentication.
- Private user information and complaint records should not be publicly accessed.
- Do not assume access to authenticated APIs or private resources.
